channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Iraqi lawmakers confirm remaining ministers five months post-formation
item.description: Legislators in Iraq have endorsed the cabinet picks put forward by al-Zaidi. This finalizes ministerial posts nearly half a year after the administration assumed power amid economic worries.

item.title: Election Commission plans voter list revision; oil import data released
item.description: The Election Commission will execute a summary update of voter rolls across 17 states and union territories. Meanwhile, India obtained over sixty percent of its August petroleum imports from three nations.

item.title: Four dead following shooting incident at Oregon primary school
item.description: Law enforcement reported four fatalities during a Thursday shooting at an elementary school located in Oregon, United States. Authorities confirmed that the suspected gunman also died at the scene.

item.title: Saudi Arabia condemns Houthi strikes as US issues airport warning
item.description: Riyadh has characterized recent Houthi assaults as acts constituting war crimes. Concurrently, Washington has cautioned about potential threats targeting airports within the kingdom.

item.title: Chief Minister claims KCR takes water unlawfully for property
item.description: The Chief Minister has accused KCR of unauthorized water extraction for his personal residence. The allegation highlights an ongoing dispute over resource usage.

item.title: Rapid diagnostic tool identifies concealed pediatric infections
item.description: Medical professionals are utilizing metagenomics to quickly spot pathogens in severe pediatric intensive care cases. The same-day examination aids clinicians in uncovering hidden illnesses.

item.title: Modi scheduled for mid-December Canada trip to strengthen relations
item.description: Prime Minister Modi will travel to Canada on December 11 and 12. The visit aims to strengthen bilateral cooperation between New Delhi and Ottawa.

item.title: Tiruvallur steps up checks on grain transit amid grower complaints
item.description: Authorities have increased monitoring of rice paddy transport in Tiruvallur. Local cultivators claim outsiders and merchants use farmers' documentation to market purchased grain.

item.title: Indian Social Worker Honored by Hillary Clinton
item.description: Former U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton presented an award to Reema Nanavaty, director of the Self-Employed Women's Association of India. The presentation took place at the Georgetown Institute for Women, Peace and Security.

item.title: High Court Orders Strict Adherence to Official Deadlines
item.description: The High Court instructed the government to mandate that all state departments strictly follow established deadlines for processing, reviewing, and answering public representations.

item.title: Chennai Enhances Dengue Testing Amid Rising Cases
item.description: Chennai has intensified dengue screening after reporting more than 4,500 infections this year, including 1,293 in September. Authorities have deployed thousands of eradication workers and organized daily medical camps.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh Introduces Novel Sugarcane Cultivars
item.description: Uttar Pradesh has launched new varieties of sugarcane with the objective of boosting agricultural output across the region.

item.title: Moscow Targets Kyiv Bridge and Black Sea Vessels
item.description: Russia announced it struck a bridge in Kyiv and two vessels in the Black Sea. This followed warnings of intensified attacks after Ukraine stated it would increase strikes on Russian refineries.

item.title: Coimbatore Athlete Vithya Ramraj Returns Home With Medals
item.description: Vithya Ramraj returned to Coimbatore following a successful athletic performance that included setting a national record and securing three medals.

item.title: Muziris Set for Global Heritage Tourism Status
item.description: The government intends to transform Muziris into an international heritage tourism destination. Plans include expanding kayaking and water taxi operations to several local areas under the heritage project.

item.title: Electrical Inspectorate Investigates Koder House Fire Origin
item.description: Investigators analyzing video footage suspect the fire at Koder House may have started on a neighboring building's terrace. Authorities believe an air conditioning unit short circuit could be the cause, though scientific tests are required.

item.title: Himanta Blames Akhil Gogoi for Flood Relief Payout Delay
item.description: Assam's Chief Minister stated that flood relief disbursements are being withheld to prevent Raijor Dal leader Akhil Gogoi from claiming credit. Gogoi has maintained a three-day sit-in protest at the State Assembly demanding the funds.

item.title: Iranian Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad Steps Down
item.description: The oil minister of the OPEC member nation has resigned from his position without providing an explanation. He had been serving in the role since August 2024.

item.title: UK Green Party Resolves to Categorize Zionism as Racism
item.description: The British political organization, which secured six percent of the vote in the 2024 general election, passed a motion defining Zionism as an ethnonationalist political ideology equivalent to racism.

item.title: AAP Escalates Protests Against CEC While BJP Criticizes Move
item.description: The AAP intensified demands for the removal of the Chief Election Commissioner and an FIR against a police officer, causing central Delhi traffic restrictions. The BJP accused the opposition of attempting to poison the political atmosphere.

item.title: Chief Minister Expected to Participate in Upcoming GST Session
item.description: The head of the state government is anticipated to take part in the scheduled Goods and Services Tax council deliberations.

item.title: Central Government Delegations Sustain Inspections in Dry Zones
item.description: Official teams dispatched by the central administration are persisting with their evaluations of regions impacted by drought conditions.

item.title: CCB Registers Cases Against Nineteen Individuals for Traffic and Public Violations
item.description: Authorities charged nineteen people following incidents involving public alcohol consumption, triple riding on motorcycles, and performing wheelies.

item.title: ইয়েমেনের প্রাসাদে হুথিদের হামলায় নিহত দুই
item.description: ইয়েমেনের আল-মাাশিক প্রেসিডেন্সিয়াল প্যালেসে ব্যালিস্টিক ক্ষেপণাস্ত্র হামলায় দুজন নিহত হয়েছেন। তথ্যমন্ত্রী জানিয়েছেন, হামলার সময় প্রধানমন্ত্রী ও অন্যান্য মন্ত্রীরা অক্ষত ছিলেন। হুথিরা এই হামলা চালায়।

item.title: Tamil Nadu Witnesses Premature Arrival of Northeast Monsoon
item.description: The regional meteorological center predicts typical seasonal precipitation levels across the state. Weather experts pointed out that an early onset does not necessarily guarantee above-average rainfall.

item.title: New medical initiative introduces fresh meniscus transplants
item.description: A novel medical initiative focused on fresh meniscus transplants has been officially introduced. The program aims to provide advanced surgical options for patients with knee injuries.

item.title: Velachery murder case leads to arrest of three migrant workers
item.description: Law enforcement officers have apprehended three migrant laborers in connection with the homicide of a fellow worker in Velachery. The suspects are currently facing police interrogation.

item.title: Fisherfolk protest proposed Secretariat construction at Foreshore Estate
item.description: Fishing communities flew black flags to protest the government's Secretariat proposal at Foreshore Estate. They are urging authorities to hand back Srinivasapuram land, construct housing for 15,000 fishermen, and hold direct consultations.

item.title: Police lodge FIR following the death of injured IIT-Delhi researcher
item.description: An official police complaint has been registered after an IIT-Delhi academician, discovered hurt inside a Munirka apartment, passed away at AIIMS hospital.

item.title: Motorcyclist dies in collision involving lorry in PM Palem
item.description: A thirty-one-year-old software professional lost their life when a truck collided with their motorcycle in PM Palem.

item.title: Traffic collision at Tank Bund claims lives of child and relative
item.description: A minor girl and her relative died in a vehicular crash at Tank Bund while celebrating a birthday outing.

item.title: Rajinikanth starrer Jailer 2 achieves strong domestic earnings
item.description: Starring Rajinikanth, the movie Jailer 2 brought in Rs 59.70 crore net domestically following its October 15 debut. Total worldwide collections hit Rs 125.25 crore, bolstered by strong opening figures.

item.title: Influencer marketing drives Cal AI to multimillion-dollar exit
item.description: Paid influencer partnerships helped Cal AI achieve viral popularity, surpassing $30 million in revenue over two years. The startup was subsequently purchased by MyFitnessPal in March for an undisclosed sum.

item.title: Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3 Collects Rs 4.25 Crore on Day 14
item.description: On its fourteenth day in theaters, Ajay Devgn's movie 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' brought in Rs 4.25 crore. Although box office numbers have slowed down, the domestic net total has surpassed Rs 333 crore, alongside substantial international revenues.

item.title: Hilary Swank Displays Baby Bump in New York After Pregnancy Announcement
item.description: After announcing her pregnancy via Instagram, 52-year-old actress Hilary Swank was photographed in New York City. Wearing a cropped white vest while exiting CBS Mornings, she displayed her baby bump and mentioned having cravings for Rice Krispies Treats.

item.title: Police State Tip-Off and Jammed Firearm Thwarted US Teen's Temple Attack
item.description: Law enforcement reported that a 19-year-old suspect planned to attack a Hindu temple in the US. The plot failed because an informant provided a tip and the suspect's gun malfunctioned outside the building.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine Exchange Attacks After Energy Ceasefire Ends
item.description: Efforts by the White House to secure an energy truce failed as Moscow launched drone strikes against central Ukrainian infrastructure. In response, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that Kyiv will resume targeting Russian oil facilities.

item.title: Supreme Court Warns of Complications If Everyone Acts as a Journalist
item.description: The Supreme Court stated that society would face significant difficulties if every individual assumed the role of a journalist.

item.title: French Prime Minister Suggests Student Protests Are Being Exploited
item.description: As labor unions and demonstrators prepare for upcoming street rallies ahead of the presidential election, the French prime minister indicated that student discontent is being manipulated.

item.title: Attacks Damage Two Pipelines in Syria Amid Energy Infrastructure Assaults
item.description: A fuel leak occurred at the Baniyas-Homs pipeline due to suspected theft, while a separate gas export line in Hasakah caught fire during a wave of attacks on energy facilities.

item.title: Wes Streeting urges US to back Ukraine on Washington visit after Starlink row
item.description: During a trip to Washington, British official Wes Streeting asked American leaders to maintain support for Ukraine and address recent bilateral friction.

item.title: Intero Biosystems Wins Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.description: Outperforming 199 competitors, Intero Biosystems captured the $100,000 grand prize at the Startup Battlefield event during TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

item.title: Indian Envoy Advises Calm Following Saudi Arabia Strikes
item.description: Following strikes on Saudi infrastructure, Indian Ambassador Vipul urged citizens to stay calm. He voiced solidarity with the Saudi leadership and condemned the aggression against civilian sites.

item.title: British Citizen Sentenced for Bogus Bereavement Charity Scams
item.description: A UK resident received a prison sentence after collecting upwards of £10,000 through fraudulent online campaigns pretending to be a mourning parent.

item.title: Valve Introduces Categorized Achievements for Steam Platform
item.description: Steam rolled out achievement sets, enabling creators to organize trophies into distinct groups for main titles and expansions. Players continue unlocking them through standard gameplay.

item.title: Modi Unveils Infrastructure Initiatives Valued at Rs 3,350 Crore in Ladakh
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated development works totaling Rs 3,350 crore in Ladakh. He stated the projects aim to propel the union territory toward advanced progress.

item.title: Musk Reaches Agreement to Resolve Legal Challenges Over Election Sweepstakes
item.description: Elon Musk and the America PAC reached tentative agreements with plaintiffs to resolve federal lawsuits in Austin, Texas. The deals await formal approval from the presiding judge.

item.title: Suspicious mail packages delivered to American election offices and lawmakers
item.description: Several election facilities and US senators received mail containing unknown substances. States affected by these deliveries include Louisiana, Ohio, and Oklahoma.

item.title: Shoppers Shift Entirely to E-Commerce Due to Frustrations with Physical Stores
item.description: Following Primark's announcement of a home delivery service, female consumers share why they prefer purchasing apparel exclusively online instead of visiting physical shops.

item.title: Selena Gomez Establishes Award Dedicated to Martin Short's Deceased Daughter
item.description: At a recent gala, Selena Gomez created the Katherine Short Legacy Award to honor Martin Short's late daughter and highlight mental health advocates. Martin Short joined her on stage for the presentation.

item.title: Paris and Berlin Form Provisional Pact to Relax European Union Vehicle Emission Standards
item.description: France and and Germany reached a preliminary agreement on Thursday to soften EU vehicle emission regulations for manufacturers. The arrangement also incorporates the UK into a domestic production initiative.

item.title: Four Dead, Including Three Minors, in American Primary School Shooting
item.description: A shooting at a US elementary school resulted in four fatalities, including three children. Law enforcement reported that the suspect died from gunfire, while further information about the incident is currently limited.

item.title: Nineteen hurt after bus collides with train near Channel Tunnel
item.description: Nineteen people sustained injuries when a bus crashed into a stationary train on the French portion of the Channel Tunnel. Two severely injured victims were airlifted, though officials reported no fatalities.

item.title: Government Bans Pornographic Content Featuring Choking and Incest in November
item.description: Authorities announced a ban on pornography depicting incest or choking starting in early November. This decision comes after a 2025 regulatory assessment conducted by Conservative peer Baroness Gabby Bertin.

item.title: Brittany Mahomes Works to Expand Women's Football Audience in Kansas City
item.description: Brittany Mahomes is assisting the Kansas City Current in drawing 18,000 spectators for their October 25 fixture against the Washington Spirit to promote the sport. Concurrently, Patrick Mahomes uses the Chiefs' early bye week to recover from a knee injury.

item.title: Celebrities Face Intense Conflict and Death March Task on The Traitors
item.description: Famous contestants clash during a round table discussion on The Traitors and must successfully complete a mission by defeating death marchers.

item.title: White House Reportedly Drafts Plans for Massive Bomb Strikes Against Iran
item.description: The White House is reportedly developing strategies to deploy the massive ordnance air blast weapon, known as the mother of all bombs, against Iran.

item.title: OpenAI Updates Chrome Extension to Let ChatGPT Access Browser Tabs
item.description: Following the removal of the ChatGPT Atlas browser, OpenAI updated its Google Chrome extension. The tool now permits ChatGPT to view open web tabs when users interact with it.

item.title: Bournemouth Secures Historic Victory in First Ever Home Match in Europe
item.description: Bournemouth achieved a historic win during their inaugural European home fixture, marking a significant milestone in the club's 127-year history.

item.title: New Technological Tools Deployed to Monitor Odors from Industrial Sites
item.description: Advanced technology is increasingly being utilized to track and measure unpleasant smells originating from landfills and industrial sites.
